summary: Match generated Effect string checks to JSON Schema Unicode length and RFC3986 URI-reference semantics.

replay.detail: No stored claims or replay changes.

schema.detail: No database or canonical JSON Schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or server admission rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Generated Effect codecs count minLength/maxLength in Unicode code points, not UTF-16 units. URI-reference formats now validate RFC3986 rather than accepting arbitrary strings. ASCII length behavior and independent server byte bounds are unchanged.

manual.detail: No migration; consume regenerated client codecs normally.

recovery.detail: Revert generator and regenerate codecs to restore prior client validation; no stored state changes.
